title: Full Compile Sweep
summary: Recompiles a project's stale units and refreshes its stored compiler findings, forcing a full build rather than the default stale-count threshold

surfaces.usage: drag-lint refresh-findings --project <X.dproj> [--db <db>] [--full] [--json] (recompile stale units + refresh compiler_findings; >=2 stale -> full build; no --db = the project's own DB)
help: drag-lint refresh-findings --project <X.dproj> [--db <db>] [--full] [--json]   (recompile stale units + refresh compiler_findings; >=2 stale -> full build; no --db = the project's own DB)
